15:58 < Filip> no, there is an api to add to them, not to read from it

15:59 < Filip> g_Sysintr2IntrMap[SysIntr]

16:00 < jal0atWrk> you should be able to look in the cpu docs and find the irq vector addresses.
16:00 < jal0atWrk> its hardwired in the cpu
16:01 < Filip> I think it's in the pb source  as well
16:01 < jal0atWrk> the cpu receives and interrupt and jump to a predetermined vector which just holds the address of the real function
